parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group container. Renders a div with role="group", coordinates selection across nested Toggle.Root buttons, and manages roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected values. Two-way by default — use `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected values, for when `value` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `value` and
only reports through `onChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not flowing
the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:value` — the common case —
needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the user changes the selection.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether at most one (`'single'`) or several (`'multiple'`) toggles can be selected.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every toggle in the group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout orientation. Controls which arrow keys move roving focus.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Keeps at least one enabled toggle selected.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the group, typically `Toggle.Root` buttons.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the group element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered group element.

props.name: context
props.description: Bindable reference to the internal group context, for advanced composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is disabled.
